Our "hot algorithm" shows old and new posts as the formula takes into account amount of votes and submission age. If you want to only see new posts, you can go to /new or /v/all/new.

Thank you! I actually greatly appreciate a focus that does not overly emphasize "newness." An article can loiter near the "front" for a week or two and still be interesting and reach an audience.

Some users have gotten into the habit of clicking new new new thanks to the webs clickbait/advertising bent the past few years but those days are changing. Be on the vanguard and stick with this.
Is that formula open for discussion? Sometimes it works weirdly, take a look at http://whoaverse.com/v/bitcoin - posts are basically sorted from oldest to newest.

I just examined why this was happening and it boils down to inactivity of /v/bitcoin. If a submission is over, say, 5 days old and only has 2-3 upvotes, it will get a rank of 0. I tweaked this a bit to not round down to zero if rank is higher than 0.005, so this should help a bit.

Formula is of course open for discussion, you can see it here. Please note that ranking is only done when users vote on submissions (or change their vote), and every x minutes as a scheduled task server-side.
Hmm, the formula looks like Hacker News ranking formula, but with multiplication instead of exponentiation. Is that a conscious decision?
No, thanks for pointing out the error, I will be using Math.Pow method instead. This will be rolled out later today. Good find!
Cool, nice to hear! I actually use HN, and I think their ranking works pretty good.
Same here, that is why I chose it :)

/v/bitcoin seems to be resorted and the new sorting looks much better, but there's still a little weirdness:

"submitted 24 days ago by Satoshi to Bitcoin (+2|−0)" is higher than "submitted 13 days ago by uiwchuasjdncayegqksd to bitcoin (+2|−0)" which is higher than "submitted 8 days ago by BashCo to bitcoin (+2|−0)"

I noticed weird ranking again here and there - take my subverse /v/Longform for example:

"submitted 17 days ago by 721r to Longform (+2|−0)" is #1 and "submitted 14 days ago by 721r to Longform (+2|−0)" is #3, but the score is the same and SubmissionAge is bigger for the first one.

Also, while we are at it, shouldn't you somehow change formula when score is 0 or negative (that's impossible on HN as downvotes don't exist, but it's possible on whoaverse).

Probably, yes, but I never really had the time to do it. Feel free to submit revisions to the formula or thoughts on what should be changed.

As for the weird ranking problem - there is a scheduled re-ranking process in the background which uses the same formula, but it only does x items at a time if their rank is higher than x. In short, we can't keep reranking entire database of submissions, so at some point, ranking needs to stop.
